collector.contracts: As-of effective complete contract set with exact activated term/preparation/readiness/review bindings; net from immutable terms, currency from certified immutable activation-baseline/contract linkage; no single-contract shortcut or signed gross used as net
collector.receipts: Confirmed same-project receipts by true receiptDate <= business cutoff; every required row must have immutable v1 receipt_accounting_basis. Gross cash for progress ratio; net for margin. No missing-basis exclusion toggle.
collector.costs: All real registered/current source rows partitioned by actual include/exclude producer; unknown/unclassified remains visible and not implicit zero. Included direct nodes need captured E source facts + active verified F stage and known net currency; payment installments are distinct actual payment IDs.
collector.sourceChains: Server constructs canonicalAccumulationKey from actual primary source identity/lineage and sourceChainKey from real payable link. Invoice/tax-support/evidence-only must exclude primary money; controlled explicit supportingSourceRefs creates actual append-only source link+reason, never amount/date heuristics. Included procurement promise excludes any absorbed same-chain payment principal; no triple counting.
collector.allocations: Use actual F basis/result/source snapshots, exact stored selected-measurement-first-v2 cents/layers. No synthetic ProjectActualCostRecord. Result version and each real source/stage lineage frozen; shared source full amount and same share source-set mutually exclusive; direct source unrelated same-payable installments remain valid.
collector.baseline: One adopted PROJECT technical-cost chain, counted once even across many contracts; original earliest approved adopted package immutable. Current handover cost from exact before/after basis verified chain; execution change delta = approved successor project cost version net minus predecessor net, each transition once. Contract gross/signed delta never cost delta. Forked/disconnected/conflicting adopted project packages reject.
collector.tax: Active F tax snapshots/evidence, deductible VAT excluded from base; non-deductible adjustment only when explicit source component not already included; pending remains unknown/pending, never automatic addition of all taxImpactAmount
collector.labor: yes if any transitive member is labor; no only if all lineage verified non-labor; otherwise unknown and strongest reversible projection/write guards
collector.zero: Known zero only exhaustive source-scope zero or authorized explicit exclusions with proofs; money knowledge separate from maturity/evaluation. Missing confirmed receipt basis or included hard evidence prevents official publish.

sourceContext.canonicalization: Exact sourceHashFactualWhitelist supersedes broad hash wording. Shared serializer and tests Root-owned. H independently recomputes derived metric assertions; payloadHash hashes the complete stored context excluding only its self-hash field.
semantics: All fields required, absent explicit null. Unknown amount value=null+nonempty reason; known amount decimal string+null reason. Proven zero needs zeroProof and exact source/scope evidence.
Known gross=net+tax in cents. Receipt cashGross=amounts.gross and net/tax from frozen confirmation contract basis, never current tax rate.

Missing receipt basis or included hard source/tax/stage/classification/amount evidence => formalEligibility missing-evidence and official G/H publication rejects. Legacy/preview may expose unavailable state but cannot publish certified current summaries or releasable gates.

Every registered cost has one explicit validated current include/exclude classification. Duplicate canonicalAccumulationKey across invoice/payment/procurement rejects. Allocated project share uses exact F frozen cents, not recomputed rounded ratio.

Empty registered scope may prove a point-in-time aggregate zero only with exhaustive collector scope hash; this does not prove mature business data. Without actual classified cost-scope evidence, maturity remains insufficient even if registered sum is zero.
All-excluded validated known records can prove included sum zero; unknown or missing hard facts cannot be hidden by an implicit exclude.
containsLabor=yes if any transitive lineage labor, no only if all verified nonlabor, otherwise unknown; unknown uses strongest sensitive group.

sourceContext.preparation: Pure derive context may use server-preallocated IDs without business persistence; preparation knowledgeCutoff is explicit, stable and included in sourceHash. sourceContext.excludeStageSemantics: Cost.stageAttributionRef/attributedStage nullable only for expressing real excluded not-yet-applicable/missing stage evidence. Include requires recordStatus confirmed/included, stageEvidenceState verified and exact nonnull stage refs plus all hard layers. Registered source explicitly excluded for a permitted stage-not-ready reason remains traceable with pendingFacts(requiredForFormalAccounting=false), preserves uncertainty and cannot become mature/normal. It does not waive confirmed receipt accounting basis or hard facts of an included source.

costRecognitionUniqueness.canonicalAccumulationKey: Uniqueness among included primary economic measurement shares in this project snapshot only; not among excluded support rows or historical snapshots.
costRecognitionUniqueness.sourceChainKey: Separate chain constraint: payable commitment/procurement exception principal and its payment principals cannot both be included. Multiple genuine installment paymentIds under one payable remain separate primary economic units.
costRecognitionUniqueness.supportingEvidence: Invoice/tax/evidence support rows explicitly exclude with real reason and primaryCostRef; same sourceChainKey is not a duplicate principal.
costRecognitionUniqueness.allocation: Share key includes actual F source-set hash+project/result identity. Same source full principal and corresponding project allocation share cannot be counted simultaneously; lock/validate source-set overlap, not a rounded allocation ratio.
costRecognitionUniqueness.rule: These exact rules supersede the broad earlier duplicate canonicalAccumulationKey across invoice/payment/procurement wording.

sourceContext.currency: Preparation with no proven source currency or multi-currency has currency=null (and unavailable aggregate Triple.currency=null); never CNY/UNKNOWN placeholder. Only formalEligibility eligible forces a unique evidenced three-letter currency. Different source currencies reject formal publication unless a separately frozen actual conversion policy exists (none here).
sourceContext.sharedShare: No fabricated ProjectActualCostRecord. allocation-share costRef/recordStatus null, sourceRef is actual F SharedCostAllocationResult, allocationResultRef/source-set hash exact. allocationSourceMembers carries real source costs/stages/governance/labor refs. Included shares require all member hard eligibility/stage evidence valid; per-source refs remain authoritative, aggregate stageEvidenceState verified only when all members qualify. Share costType=null when representing actual allocation result (never invent a unified-cost enum); members retain actual costType/businessDate. Share businessDate is actual F result effective business date under G frozen window policy, not a guessed member date.
sourceContext.outputRefCapturePolicy: Only upstream facts enter sourceHash. New self/result restatedSnapshotRef/restatementRef/new-paired-periodEndSnapshotRef are null at immutable capture and never backfilled; result links use SQL FK/response. Existing restatesSnapshotRef and actual existing period root remain sources.

x-semanticValidation.required: Validate real records and exact amounts/hashes; JSON Schema cannot prove scope, sums, lineage, authorization or policy.

x-moneyCapacity.representation: exact decimal strings / checked integer cents (i128); no f64/JS Number totals or money formatter as authority
x-moneyCapacity.knownSourceAdmission: Actual money may have trailing zero scale from storage/text, but converting to cents must be exact. Strip only insignificant zeros; nonzero sub-cent digits reject422, never round legacy money into a new baseline. Do not apply this money rule to legitimate quantity/unit_price/rate precision.
x-moneyCapacity.aggregateAdmission: Each known published monetary aggregate independently fits +/-MAX_CENTS with its field sign constraint: baseline components/deltas, contract totals, confirmed receipt totals, included/excluded cost totals, pending tax/recognized adjustment, cost variance and margin. Amounts in context JSON are not unlimited sidecars.
x-moneyCapacity.sourceEconomicLayers: Validate net/tax/gross and actual source sets separately; gross=net+tax exactly. Do not sum receipt+cost as a monetary precondition for a later subtraction, or reject a valid zero margin from two separately bounded maxima.

overflow.timing: checked sums/products/differences and full aggregate bounds before snapshot/baseline/period/H aggregate INSERT or returned certified current result. Producer changes within the same outer transaction must roll back if later capacity validation fails. Never rely on PostgreSQL22003 for a valid source.
overflow.i128Overflow: checked arithmetic failure maps to the same typed422, never500 or wrap

nonCentHistory.rule: retain original source/history bytes; formal new V1 consumption blocked until a real separately authorized corrected source exists; no migration mass rounding/backfill

x-moneyCapacity.unknown: unknown is null+knowledge+reason, not known zero; no numeric range test on null and no COALESCE to0
x-moneyCapacity.zero: known0.00 is permitted only with existing source/complete-scope proof; exact derived zero margin from equal known amounts is known, not missing
x-moneyCapacity.negative: margin/cost variance/change delta can be negative; preserve signed cents and H low-receipt/maturity policy. Nonnegative totals remain nonnegative.
x-moneyCapacity.ratios: Unrounded rational for classification, six-place half-away-from-zero display, existing frozen numeric(38,6) for gross_margin_rate. Zero denominator gives null/reason, not0; money MAX is not a ratio bound.
x-moneyCapacity.persistence: 20 existing monetary targets and8 new monetary fields already numeric(18,2). No sidecar-only workaround needed; v1 actually writes legacy aggregate columns and must honor their full common capacity.

rootWiring.common: Root owns a single exact money type/range guard in project_operating_common; G collector/writer and H context/policy assertion validator consume the same guard. Match existing E MONEY_MAX; do not expand C/E/F ordinary amount admission.
rootWiring.errors: Root adds typed422 mapping and current shared error schema; G/H cannot throw database overflow as normal source rejection.
rootWiring.beforeG1: Append this capacity delta as input clarification to the formal baseline/manifest; do not rewrite or retrospectively claim the sealed v1 audit included it.
